rec: Amulet of Glory for faster teleport to Draynor Village.

st.t: Talk to Veos in The Sheared Ram pub in Lumbridge to start the quest.
s: Sounds good, what should I do?

st.t: Dig north of Bob's Brilliant Axes, on the west side of the plant against the wall of his house.
Dig behind Lumbridge Castle, just outside the kitchen door: stand one tile south-west of the large crate there.
Go to Draynor Village. Dig north-west of the jail, by the wheat farm: four tiles north of the bush near Leela.
Dig just inside the pig pen in the Draynor Market.
Talk to Veos directly south of the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim to finish the quest.
